title: Monban conformance report (frozen interface F13)
description: Signed JSON report emitted by conformance/ for a build or a third-party extension. Levels C0-C4 (C3 model DRT, C4 traceability of the F1 statement ledger; gated from Phase 8, see `gated`); the golden reference claims only what its gates executed.

gated.description: Amended 2026-11-06 (P8-conformance-001, PREFLIGHT D-P8.5; additive, v stays 1; absent = not stated, read as C0-C2 as before Phase 8). The levels this report's gate required at 100% (passed == total) for this subject; a level in `levels` but not here was reported, not gated. Phase 8 gate conformance-full: C0-C4 for golden subjects.

config_sha256.description: Amended 2026-11-06 (P8-conformance-001, PREFLIGHT D-P8.5 config-pin; additive, v stays 1; absent = no config pin). The effective-config hash (monban-config config_hash: SHA-256 of the canonical effective F8 JSON) of the subject's golden config, pinned in conformance/config-pin.toml. Present only if every boot record of the subject in this run (conformance/boot-pin: check-config, the boot log line and /healthz agree) names this hash and the report's artifact_sha256; a subject that booted with a different hash gets no report.

test_keys.description: true iff the signatures were made with per-run test keys (PLAN-6 D-P2, REL-4); absent means false. A verifier refuses a report with test_keys true unless it is run with --allow-test-keys.

signatures.description: Amended 2026-11-04 (P6-spec-001, PLAN-6 Interfaces F13; was a single `signature`; v stays 1, no consumer existed). Exactly three signatures, one per algorithm, in this order, all over the same message: the same report with the `signatures` member removed, serialized as Python json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8 (REL-1: accepted only if all three verify).

sig.description: standard base64 of the raw signature bytes
